# Architecture Decision Records

Create ADRs from the [MADR template](../../docs/internal/architecture/adr/template.md),
assign the next sequential number, and add accepted decisions to the
[ADR index](../../docs/internal/architecture/adr/index.md). Record context,
drivers, considered options, consequences, and a concrete confirmation method.

Do not rewrite an existing decision. Create a new ADR that supersedes it, then
change the old ADR status to `superseded by ADR-NNNN`.
